_comment: Apps whose screenshots may be described by an AI model. DEFAULT-DENY:
anything not listed here stays in the album but is never analyzed, never
summarized, and never sent to a cloud provider. That covers every browser
capture and the ~9% of screenshots with no app name in the filename.
Entries are case-insensitive substrings of the Android package name, so
'hafas' covers both the German and Austrian rail apps. Add an app only if
you are comfortable with its contents leaving your machine.
Deliberately absent, and worth keeping absent: messaging (tencent.mm,
whatsapp, telegram, mms), mail (outlook, gmail), banking and payments
(alipay), health, and all browsers. Airline apps too - 'klm' was listed
here and removed, because a boarding pass or baggage screen shows the
passenger's full name by design. Rail apps stay: their ticket screens do
not, on this library.
Run `npm run --workspace pipeline scan` after editing to re-apply.
Extended 2026-10-13 with travel and utility tools whose screens carry no
personal identifiers: rail booking and timetables, maps, a museum guide,
weather, a compass, the system gallery. The rule used was 'would a screenshot
of this screen ever hold a name, a payment, a message or an ID?' — airlines,
ticket resellers, banks, browsers, shopping, social and games stay out for
that reason, and so does the launcher (notification banners carry messages).
